_doc: Independent signal classes for the token comparator (PLAN §1.5a). Written from the spec tables (rinex211.txt §10.1.1 / Table A1; rinex305.txt Tables 14-20; rinex_4.02.txt Tables 10-16), NOT from rinexcore/spec. A token's class is SYSTEM:TYPE:BAND[:GROUP]. RINEX 2 code letters C and P are distinguished for GPS and GLONASS by GROUP; RINEX 3 attributes map onto the same GROUPs. BeiDou B1I is band 1 in 3.02 and band 2 elsewhere (3.01, 3.03+, and the 2-char 'C2' family). The only BeiDou band-1 signal with attribute I or Q any version defines is B1I (3.02, rinex302.txt p.20), so band-1 I/Q is B1I whatever the file's version; band-1 X is B1I before 3.04 and B1C from 3.04 (rinex304.txt p.26). Band 2 (1561.098 MHz) with I, Q or X is B1I in every version that defines it (rinex301.txt Table 5 'E2', rinex305.txt Table 19 'B1 / 1561.098'); 3.02 defines no BeiDou band 2, so a 3.02 file's C2I is B1I too.
